**Status: No access to external runtime environments.**

Paste the relevant log segment below for analysis.

**Common Retrieval Commands:**

**Linux (Systemd/syslog)**
```bash
journalctl -xeu <service_name> --no-pager | tail -n 50
tail -f /var/log/syslog
```

**Docker**
```bash
docker logs --tail 50 --follow <container_id>
```

**Kubernetes**
```bash
kubectl logs -f <pod_name> -n <namespace> --previous
```

**AWS CloudWatch**
```bash
aws logs get-log-events --log-group-name <group> --log-stream-name <stream> --limit 20
```
